claimText:
Fix Aboriginal Studies 30 tablet/mobile unit-card title visibility and hide the progress panel in top-sidebar mode.

Goal:
- Keep unit-card titles visible in narrow/tablet states.
- Prevent generic stack-card responsive rules from overriding the AS30 unit-card grid.
- Hide the large course progress panel when the sidebar moves to the top on tablet/phone widths.
- Apply the fix to both the active workspace stylesheet and the AS30 builder template.

Acceptance boundary:
- Do not edit raw imports.
- Do not deploy, publish, sync, or release.
- Keep scope to AS30 workspace/meta CSS, focused regression tests, visual proof images, handoff, and STAX report/task files.
